basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old living in Gothenburg, Sweden. I'm a paramedic by profession and have a keen interest in gaming, primarily focusing on life simulators like Animal Crossing. In my downtime, I enjoy fishing, both virtually and in real life, and have a soft spot for online floral arrangements. I'm currently single and find solace in quiet island adventures. My typical online hours are during late evenings after my shifts, when I unwind with some gaming and Reddit browsing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in emergency medical services, having worked as a paramedic for over 5 years. My knowledge is mostly gained through hands-on experience and continuous learning courses in the medical field. I'm also self-taught in various gaming strategies, especially those related to simulation games.
